label: Coverage inactive on date of service
description: The member is known but has no active coverage on the date of service. CRD 2.0.1 has no code for this; the CRD 2.2.0 ballot's no-active-coverage reason is also recognised when a service sends it.
basis: Synthetic. The coverage information follows Da Vinci CRD 2.0.1, the version this tool judges by. CRD 2.0.1 ships no model of a CDS Hooks response, so the cards and system actions around it follow CDS Hooks as this tool reads it. It has not been observed from the live service.
assumption: How the live service signals inactive coverage is not known. This file models covered=not-covered with a reason coded coverage-inactive under a placeholder code system.
